description.text:
We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to build high-quality interactive web applications and web-based gaming experiences. If you're passionate about modern frontend technologies, creating engaging user experiences, and writing clean, scalable code, we'd love to hear from you.
# Responsibilities
1. Design, develop, and maintain interactive web applications and game-related frontend features.
2. Build scalable, high-performance frontend solutions using modern JavaScript and TypeScript.
3. Develop responsive and engaging user interfaces with React, PixiJS, or other modern frontend technologies.
4. Implement real-time features using WebSocket and efficiently handle live data updates.
5. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best engineering practices.
6. Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to team members.
7. Collaborate closely with designers, backend engineers, and product teams to deliver polished user experiences.
8. Proactively identify technical improvements, explore new technologies, and develop proof-of-concepts when appropriate.
# Qualifications
1. 5+ years of professional experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
2. Strong experience with modern frontend development and component-based architecture.
3. Hands-on experience with React, PixiJS, or similar frontend frameworks/libraries.
4. Experience with state management, asynchronous data handling, and modern frontend tooling.
5. Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development.
6. Experience implementing WebSocket or other real-time communication technologies.
7. Solid understanding of web performance optimization and frontend best practices.
8. Proficiency in both English and Chinese, written and spoken.
# Nice to have
1. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
2. Experience developing browser games or other highly interactive web applications.
3. Experience with animation technologies such as WebGL, SVG, Canvas API, Three.js, or similar libraries.
4. Experience with game development frameworks such as PixiJS, Cocos Creator, Unity, or HTML5 game engines.
5. Experience optimizing rendering performance and application responsiveness.
6. Experience with Electron or other cross-platform desktop application frameworks.
7. Experience with audio/video streaming technologies or multimedia applications.
8. Familiarity with modern testing frameworks and frontend development tools.
